final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article. Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover about ASP.NET Core Minimal API Endpoint Filters. The reader should quickly understand that a request passes through validation before the handler, then the response passes back through logging after processing. Summary angle: portray an Endpoint Filter as one transparent bidirectional inspection gate wrapped around a central API processing core. Narrative flow: 3-beat process in a 2.35:1 frame with one dominant focal subject. Information blocks: step one, a request parcel enters from the left and passes an inspection gate with the approved label '校验'; step two, the central processing core receives the approved request with the label '处理'; step three, a response exits to the right through a restrained timing and logging device with the label '记录'. Main metaphor: a bidirectional inspection gate wrapping an API handler. Subject: one grounded software engineer operating the transparent filter gate and central processing core, actively guiding the request through and observing the response return. Composition/framing: diagonal left-to-right progression, the filter gate as the only strong focal point, request on the left, processing core in the center, response on the right, ample negative space, aspect ratio 2.35:1. Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with mature realistic comic illustration, grounded anatomy, restrained expressions, cinematic everyday lighting, detailed but readable scenes. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-story cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: deep graphite gray, teal, warm amber, cool white. Visible text policy: allow only the three approved short Chinese labels '校验', '处理', and '记录'. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names. Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter. Avoid real IDE screens, fake code, complex architecture diagrams, generic robots, code rain, neon cities, and crowds.
